newsitem.title: USA: NYPA 965 MW Indian Point 3 nuke hits 75 pct power.
newsitem.headline: NYPA 965 MW Indian Point 3 nuke hits 75 pct power.

text.p: New York Power Authority's (NYPA) 965 megawatt (MW) Indian Point 3 nuclear unit hit 75 percent power after being restarted earlier this week, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.
In its daily status report, the NRC said the unit would hold at this level to repair a packing steam leak on the secondary side of the plant.
NYPA said Thursday it expected Indian Point 3 would resume full output by this weekend.
The unit, along the Hudson River north of New York City, was shut a month for various repairs.

The adjacent 975 MW Indian Point 2, operated by Consolidated Edison Co of New York, is expected to resume operation by early next week after being shut January 27 to correct problems that made feedwater valve inoperable.
